resources.string: ReelBlocker monitors Instagram and YouTube to detect when short-form video players (Reels and Shorts) are active. When detected, it automatically navigates you away from the player. No personal data is collected, stored, or transmitted. This service only inspects screen elements within Instagram and YouTube apps.
Accessibility Service is disabled — tap to enable

This app uses Android's Accessibility Service to monitor screen content exclusively within Instagram and YouTube apps.

What it does:
• Detects when Reels or Shorts players are active
• Automatically navigates you away from short-form content

What it does NOT do:
• Collect, store, or transmit any personal data
• Access any app other than Instagram and YouTube
• Read your messages, passwords, or private information

All processing happens locally on your device.
Battery optimization may stop the blocker from running. Tap to disable it for this app.
